confidence_notes: Restaurant and bar anchors come from second-hand sources: Numbeo-derived figures reproduced by Expatica (snapshot 1 June 2026), a 2023 Tampa bar-price study cited by local radio, and scattered current menu and Expatistan data. Coffee and beer are supported by individual menus and are less certain as citywide typicals. Cocktail and wine_glass are bounded estimates. Wine uses the reported bottle-level figure (about $15) and a typical glass markup, and the cocktail figure reflects the $12-14 range. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Tampa's lodging market and were not checked against live listings. FX: the RBA AUD/USD 4pm rate of 0.6720 for 2026-11-18 was taken from a search summary of the RBA exchange-rates page; the 2026-11-19 observation was not yet visible.
comparable_city_reasoning: Treated as a mid-sized US Sun Belt metro with a moderate-cost downtown and Ybor City dining scene. Restaurant anchors are benchmarked to US mid-sized city cost-of-living indexes, and accommodation to typical Tampa motel, hostel and mid-market hotel rates for July.
